pairs.difference: A: daylight mid-key card. The light false front, mid walls and black door opening form clear groups, and the numbers are in range. B: the night sky sinks almost to the darkest level across the top and right. The only lights are thin neon tubes and small yellow windows, and the lens sky breaks into speckle at the dark/mid border. B's mean (0.487) is below the real range and its hero gap (0.284) is well above it.
pairs.fix: Lift the whole card to a brighter dusk blue so the sky reads as a middle grey, not near black. Make the sign panels broad, lit shapes, and keep the deepest darks only under the balcony and sign edges.

pairs.difference: A: dark cart on a light sky and sand, with gold nuggets as a lighter cluster on top. Its gap (-0.302) is slightly past the range, but the groups are simple. B: the scroll is pushed to near-white over most of its length against black top corners, with a dark-to-mid arch glowing behind it. Hero gap (0.313) and RMS (0.213) are both clearly out of range.
pairs.fix: Drop the scroll to a warm mid-light cream with soft shaded folds, leaving pure light only on the top edge. Lift the top corners from near black to a medium blue and remove the arch-shaped glow behind the scroll.

pairs.difference: A: a pale blown-out halo hugs the ring box and the rays dissolve into it, while the corners fall to dark. Vignette (0.162) is above the real range. The box adds a near-black band around a white cushion, which is a hard local jump. B: rays run crisply to the edges in separate light and dark bands, the star sits in soft light-to-mid faces, and the ruby is one compact dark accent. B's gap (0.201) is somewhat high, but the design is cleaner.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright glow around the box and let even, crisp light and dark rays run out to the corners. Keep the corners only slightly darker than the centre, and soften the box rim from black to deep red.

pairs.difference: A: the cap is a flat dark shape on a simple light disc inside a mid field, making very few groups. Its gap (-0.312) is just past the range, but the structure is clean. B: the corner wall is near black with streaky wood lines, floorboards scatter light slivers, and a hot white crown sits on a black band. Its mean (0.5) is below range, RMS (0.183) is above range and vignette (-0.04) is below range.
pairs.fix: Brighten the back wall to a warm middle tone with quiet, smooth planks and no black streaks. Calm the floor into one even light shape, and shade the white crown down so it is not clipped.

pairs.difference: A: a dark door mass with black shadow under the lintel, framed by broken leaf flecks. It is busy, but it has a real dark anchor. Mean and vignette sit just at the edge of the range. B: the sky and grass merge into a light field, with mid-grey legs close to that field. There is almost no dark accent, so mean (0.736) runs high and RMS (0.109) runs low. The sails are the only hard contrast.
pairs.fix: Darken the sky to a deeper blue at the top, and give the tower legs deep shadow sides plus a dark contact shadow on the grass so the structure stands against the field.

pairs.difference: A: strong groups, with a white-and-dark awning, a dark cart body and pale paving. B: a mid-field background with the twig ball breaking into fine light and dark flecks. All four numbers are in range on both cards, and the ball's fragmentation comes from its subject. Nothing on value picks one out.

A: the horseshoe sits close to the background rings in value and separates mainly by hue. Gentle mid tones carry a few narrow highlights and one soft dark underside. B: the blue pillow is one heavy dark-mid mass with black jagged pleats around a clipped white hole, a sudden central jump. Hero-ring borders and the bottom edges are speckled in the lens, and the rings lose separation.
pairs.fix: Lighten the pillow to a medium blue with a soft lit top, soften the pleats to gentle shading without black spikes, and tone down the white glow in the hole to match the pink rings around it.

pairs.difference: A: the arch is a mid-dark mass of leaves and roses with graded tones, set on stripes and a pale opening. Its gap (-0.278) is slightly past the range. B: the piano is nearly solid black, with a few mid planes and hardly any middle steps, and the keys form one hard white strip. RMS (0.218) and gap (-0.352) are both far out of range.
pairs.fix: Raise the piano to a rich medium red-brown with visible lighter top planes and panel faces, keeping black only under the keyboard lid and at the floor contact.

pairs.difference: A: a spotlight wedge behind the trophy gives a simple light-mid-dark layout, and the gold holds soft graded bands. Its numbers are only just past the range. B: near-white capital and column shaft against black wall corners, with speckled noise at top left and hard white ridges. Mean (0.514) is below range, RMS (0.201) is above range and gap (0.295) is far above range.
pairs.fix: Brighten the walls to a medium wine red with no black corners. Shade the column to a warm cream with soft fluting so only the top slab and scroll edges are the lightest.

pairs.difference: A: dark pot with black shade and a bright glow behind it, on a mid-value table. The numbers are at the range edge, and it has a full light-mid-dark stack. B: the floor is blown to one flat white field and the wall is one flat light grey. Mean (0.762) is above range, the shoes are only mid grey, and no broad dark group anchors the card.
pairs.fix: Darken the floor to a warm golden tone with a gradient, so it is not white. Give the shoes deep shadow under the soles and between them, and darker sides on the uppers.

pairs.difference: A: a very high key, with mean (0.803) above range and a white patchy glow directly behind the harmonica. The hero's top melts into that glow, and dark only appears in the small reed holes. B: the scarf is a simple dark mass on lighter swirls, with a few black folds and vignette in range.
pairs.fix: Remove the white glow behind the harmonica and deepen the background to an even golden orange. Darken the lower half of the metal body so it separates from the field.

pairs.difference: A: cards at clipped white over a soft black shadow, with black suit marks as accents. Mean (0.769) is slightly high, but this suits the subject. B: the ball is split into light and mid panels with mid-grey shadow on bright sand. It is also high key (0.738), and contrast is similar at 0.132 to 0.135. The two cards fail in about the same mild way, so value gives no reason to choose.

pattern: Generated cards push value to extremes. Heroes go to near-white or solid near-black against the field, so the gap falls outside the real range and few middle steps remain. Near-black corners, or a blown glow hugging the hero, replace crisp even background bands. Wood and sky scenes break into streaks or speckle in the lens. Real cards hold broader, simpler masses with graded roll-off and compact dark accents.
